description:
Brand Introduction: Welcome to the Kranite Affiliate Program! We're thrilled to partner with you to promote our exceptional range of products. At Kranite, we specialize in unique and high-quality items, making us a standout choice for discerning customers looking for something extraordinary.

Product Description: Our catalog boasts a diverse selection of products, from precious metal collectibles to cutting-edge gadgets. Each item is meticulously crafted and chosen to cater to those with an appreciation for craftsmanship and innovation. Notably, our products have collectively raised over $2 million on Kickstarter, a testament to their appeal and uniqueness. They've also been featured on Touch of Modern, a prestigious platform for innovative and cutting-edge products. Average order value is $200.

USP (Unique Selling Point): What sets Kranite apart is our commitment to excellence. We offer customers more than just products; we provide them with experiences. With exclusive access to limited edition items, your audience can own unique treasures they won't find anywhere else.

Payment Terms: Our affiliate program offers competitive commissions, with a transparent payment structure. You'll earn a commission for every sale generated through your referral links. Payments are made on a regular basis, ensuring you receive your earnings promptly.

Other Information:

  • Dedicated Support: We provide our affiliates with excellent support, including creative materials, tracking tools, and personalized assistance to help you maximize your earnings.

  • Cookie Duration: Our cookies have a generous lifespan, ensuring you receive credit for sales even if they occur weeks after the initial click.

  • Marketing Resources: Gain access to a library of marketing resources, including banners, text links, and promotional content to help you effectively promote Kranite products.

  • Quality Assurance: Rest assured, Kranite products are of the highest quality. We stand by the craftsmanship and authenticity of every item we sell.

Join us in sharing the Kranite experience with the world. Together, we'll introduce customers to a world of unique finds and extraordinary treasures. Join our affiliate program today and start earning commissions while offering your audience something truly special.
